Pongo's London FlatOne Hundred and One DalmatiansNinety-nine puppies. One big pot.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersPongo and Perdita's spotty cheese strawsPuff pastry with cheddar, parmesan, black olives and nigella seedsHow to make it2 sheets of puff pastry, thawed1 egg, beaten80g cheddar, grated30g parmesan, grated50g black olives, finely chopped1 tsp nigella seedsLay out one pastry sheet and brush with beaten egg.Scatter over the cheddar, parmesan, olives and nigella seeds.Lay the second sheet on top and press down firmly.Cut into strips, twist each a few times and lay on lined trays.Bake at 200°C until golden and crisp.Sooty puppy black sesame potato chipsThe puppies rolling in soot to disguise themselvesHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thin crisp potato chips tossed in a sooty seasoning of black sesame, smoked salt and crumbled nori, the puppies' chimney-soot disguise.Slice 4 large potatoes paper thin on a mandoline, soak in cold water 20 minutes, then dry thoroughly.Fry in small batches at 170°C for 3 minutes until crisp and golden, and drain.Grind 2 tbsp toasted black sesame seeds, 1 sheet of nori and 1 tsp smoked salt to a coarse dust.Toss the hot chips in the seasoning and serve in a big bowl.Scotch eggs with English mustardThunderbolt's on the telly. Patch won't share.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsRoger and Anita's shepherd's pieLamb mince with carrots and peas under buttery mashHow to make it800g lamb mince1 tbsp olive oil1 brown onion, diced2 carrots, grated1 cup frozen peas250ml beef stock1kg potatoes50g butter100ml milksalt and pepper, to tasteDice the onion and grate the carrots.Brown the mince with the onion and carrot in the olive oil.Add the peas and stock and simmer until thick, then season with salt and pepper.Peel and chop the potatoes, boil until tender, then mash with butter and milk.Spread the mince in a dish and top with the mash.Bake at 200°C until golden.Nanny's roast beef and Yorkshire pudsNanny looking after the house and the puppiesHow to make itAs written, serves 4Mustard-crusted beef topside roasted pink, with puffed Yorkshire puddings, crunchy roast potatoes and lashings of onion gravy.Rub a 1.5kg beef topside with 1 tbsp English mustard and salt and roast at 200°C for 50 minutes for medium, with 1kg parboiled potato chunks in oil around it.Rest 20 minutes.Whisk 150g plain flour, 3 eggs and 300ml milk.Heat 1 tsp oil in each hole of a 12-hole muffin tin at 230°C, pour in the batter and bake 20 minutes.Fry 1 sliced onion, add 1 tbsp flour and 400ml beef stock and simmer.SweetsBlack and white cookiesSoft buttermilk cookies iced half white, half chocolateHow to make it125g butter, softened150g caster sugar1 egg300g self-raising flour125ml buttermilk200g icing sugar2 tbsp cocoa3 tbsp water1/2 tsp vanilla extractBeat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the egg.Mix in the flour and buttermilk.Spoon rounds onto lined trays.Bake at 180°C until set and lightly golden.Cool on the trays.Mix the icing sugar with the water and vanilla into a glaze, then stir the cocoa into half of it to make a chocolate glaze. Ice half of each cookie with each.Leave to set.Barn honey shortbread with warm milk dipButtery honey shortbread, with warm milk for dippingHow to make it200g butter, soft70g caster sugar3 tbsp honey300g plain flourpinch of salt600ml milk1 tsp vanilla extractBeat the butter, sugar and some of the honey until pale.Mix in the flour and salt.Press into a lined tin and prick all over.Bake at 160°C until pale gold.Cut into fingers while warm, then cool in the tin.Warm the milk with the remaining honey and the vanilla. Serve in small cups for dunking.DrinksThunderbolt black and white shakeVanilla and chocolate shakes poured side by side, whipped cream and chocolate dropsHow to make it500ml vanilla ice cream500ml chocolate ice cream600ml cold milk1 tsp vanilla extract1 tbsp cocoa100ml whipped cream50g dark chocolate dropsBlend the vanilla ice cream with half the milk and the vanilla. Pour into a jug.Blend the chocolate ice cream with the remaining milk and the cocoa. Pour into a second jug.Pour both shakes into tall glasses at the same time from either side so they sit half and half.Top with whipped cream and chocolate drops for spots.
